content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to understand the process for updating [product_name] firmware from [version_no] 1.82.02.

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. This is an English-language forum, so please write future posts in English. You can only perform a firmware update from [version_no] 1.82.02 to [version_no] 1.82.04, not to the latest [version_no] 1.83.01. You will need a FAT32-formatted MicroSD card. Download the firmware update from [url]. Extract the file and save it on your PC. Back up your user program from [product_name] to your PC. Copy the three firmware update files into the root directory of the MicroSD card without modifying file names, as altering them may prevent successful updating. Power off [product_name], insert the MicroSD card, then power it on. Ensure a stable power supply during the update, following the requirements described in the [document]. After updating, verify the firmware version and check your user program, functions, and settings; adjust as needed.
